notes.notes:
[p]Hello,[/p][p]We just released a patch that includes a bunch of UX & UI fixes!
[/p]

notes.title: Fishing Valley Update – New Features and Improvements! 🎣
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, Anglers! [/h2]

We've been hard at work improving Fishing Valley based on your feedback. This update brings some exciting new features and quality-of-life changes to enhance your fishing experience. Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] Display of available bait quantity during fishing.
[*] Notification when bait is used.
[*] Failed fishing attempts now have a 30% chance of losing bait (previously 100%).
[*] Added a "diving" feature for faster bait sinking.
[*] Display of boat loading status.
[*] Replaced quest progress bars with checkmarks for caught fish.
[*] Quest rewards are given when speaking to the quest giver.
[*] Item details now appear when hovering.
[*] Improved controller vibrations.
[*] Adjustments to the character leveling system.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these updates and look forward to hearing your thoughts!

notes.title: New Control Options – Keyboard and Mouse Support Added!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, Anglers![/h2]

We’ve heard your feedback, and we’re excited to announce that Fishing Valley now supports keyboard and mouse controls! ⌨️🖱️

Previously, a controller was required to play, but with this new update, you can enjoy the game with your preferred setup. Whether you’re fishing with a controller or casting your line with a keyboard and mouse, the peaceful adventure of Fishing Valley is now more accessible than ever.

Try it out and let us know how it feels!

Best,
Mike

notes.title: Fishing Valley at Steam Next Fest – Play Now!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, Anglers![/h2]

We’re thrilled to announce that Fishing Valley is participating in October’s Steam Next Fest! 🎣 While the demo is already available on Steam, this is a great time to dive into the relaxing world of Fishing Valley and explore:

[list]
[*] Take on fishing quests using intuitive quick time events.
[*] Unlock new gear to enhance your adventure.
[*] Customize your aquarium with your best catches.
[/list]

Join us during Steam Next Fest to celebrate fishing and share your experience!

Best,
Mike Carter
